content.short: AnCrypto is the world's first chat and pay multichain crypto wallet.
content.description: AnCrypto reimagines wallet addresses by replacing long, complex strings with simple usernames. With these usernames, you can send and receive crypto quickly, without memorizing or risking exposure of a traditional address. Each username acts as your digital identity across the Web3 space, helping you engage with peers, marketplaces, and services in a more natural, unified way. As a multichain wallet, AnCrypto supports ERC-721 and ERC-1155 assets, enabling diverse non-fungible tokens and fungible tokens to move across compatible networks with ease.
